scripts.translation:
[神射手]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
One shot.
One kill.
It's not so hard
once you develop the
vision for that style
of battling.
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
一箭毙命。
只要练就适合这种战法的眼力，就不难做到。

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
The world is in
need of mighty Bowmen
like you. Are you ready for
the awesome responsibility?
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
世界需要你这样强大的弓箭手。
你准备好承担这份重任了吗？

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Are you willing to
take the next step and
become a Sniper?
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
你愿意更进一步，成为神射手吗？

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
准备好了，随时回来吧。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
你还有可以学习的技能。
请用完剩余的技能点，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Congratulations!
As a Sniper, I hope
that the minions of evil
will never be safe so
long as they are in
your sight!
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
恭喜！
愿你身为神射手，让所有进入你视野的邪恶爪牙，都无处可逃！

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
在这里安心休息吧。
向勇士们致敬！
